note: Research data for Snek. qty = raw on-chain units. Each tx is applied once (dedupe by tx hash). tokens[].policy is the first 8 hex of the policy. A holding is a duplicate only when the full unit (policy id + asset name) matches; that copy is dup_of / same_qty_as and is left out of positions_counted. Different policy ids are different assets, even when the ticker and the quantity match.
